newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open little changed Wednesday after the London market erased most of its overnight gains, traders said.

LIFFE cocoa futures were still firmer today but below highs as continued strength in Sterling against the mark weighed on the market. At the midday break, September was up three stg at 1,046 stg a tonne after peaking at 1,053 stg.

Tuesday, New York cocoa futures ended broadly higher as the market bounced back after four straight sessions of losses. September settled up $20 at $1,578 a tonne after ranging from $1,588 to $1,545. Spot July closed up the same at $1,556, with the rest $17 to $20 higher.

Technically, traders now focused on a chart gap on the upside between Monday's high of $1,590 and $1,610 for September cocoa. While the gap will probably be filled, they said September was likely to trade in a sideways range in the near term between $1,520 and $1,650.
